# Math Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Absolute](/docs/standard-library/math/absolute) | Gives the absolute value of a number. |
| [Floor](/docs/standard-library/math/floor) | Rounds a number down to the nearest integer. |
| [Ceiling](/docs/standard-library/math/ceiling) | Rounds a number up to the nearest integer. |
| [Round](/docs/standard-library/math/round) | Rounds a number to a given number of digits after the point. |
| [Min](/docs/standard-library/math/min) | Finds the least number in an array. |
| [Max](/docs/standard-library/math/max) | Finds the greatest number in an array. |
| [Power](/docs/standard-library/math/power) | Raises a number to a power. |
| [SquareRoot](/docs/standard-library/math/squareroot) | Gives the square root of a number. |
| [Log](/docs/standard-library/math/log) | Gives the logarithm of a number, natural or to a given base. |
| [Sum](/docs/standard-library/math/sum) | Adds up the numbers in an array. |
| [Average](/docs/standard-library/math/average) | Gives the mean of the numbers in an array. |
| [Clamp](/docs/standard-library/math/clamp) | Limits a number to a range. |
| [Median](/docs/standard-library/math/median) | Gives the middle value of the numbers in an array. |
| [Mode](/docs/standard-library/math/mode) | Finds the number that occurs most often in an array. |
| [RandomInt](/docs/standard-library/math/randomint) | Returns a random integer from a range. |
